itineraryLine: 1. Flight from SFO to ICN Airport, South Korea
transitFromHotel: Arrival point (ICN Terminal 1 or Terminal 2)
flagNote: Crosses International Date Line: Saturday Oct 31 SFO departure arrives Sunday Nov 1 in Korea.

itineraryLine: 2a. Travel from ICN to Seoul: Arex (airport train) 45 min, $7
verifiedName: AREX Airport Railroad Express Train (공항철도 직통열차)
location: ICN B1 Transit Center → Seoul Station B2/B7
verifiedCost: 13,000 KRW (~$9.50 USD) Adult Express / 4,450–5,050 KRW All-Stop
transitFromHotel: From Seoul Station, transfer to Subway Line 4 (2 stops to Myeong-dong Stn) or 7-min taxi to Stanford Hotel Myeongdong.
flagNote: Express Train adult fare was raised from 9,500 KRW (~$7) to 13,000 KRW (~$9.50). Duration is 43 min (T1) / 51 min (T2) to Seoul Station; requires transfer to reach Myeongdong.

itineraryLine: 2b. Travel from ICN to Seoul: Airport Limosine bus $13
location: ICN T1 (Stop 5B) / T2 (B1) → Lotte Hotel / IBIS Myeong-dong Stop
transitFromHotel: Stops at 'Lotte Hotel / IBIS Myeong-dong', a 2-minute flat walk (120m) to Stanford Hotel Myeongdong.
flagNote: Recommended over AREX with heavy luggage because it drops off 120m from the hotel lobby. Per official 2026 notice, purchase bus tickets at the airport ticket booth/kiosk before boarding.

itineraryLine: 3. Check into Stanford Hotel in Myeongdong (Light neighborhood exploration & rest)
hours: Check-in: After 15:00 / Check-out: Before 12:00 (24h Front Desk)
transitFromHotel: Base Hotel (Subway Line 2 Euljiro 1-ga Stn Exit 5/6, 2-min walk)
flagNote: Check-in lobby is on the 9th floor above Apple Myeongdong. Free self-service luggage storage lockers on 9F.

itineraryLine: 1. Take bus to Namsun Tower (N Seoul Tower). 31 min. bus ride. Observatory 10:00-10:30 (entry until 10:00)
hours: Mon–Fri: 10:00–22:30 (Sat–Sun: 10:00–23:00); Last entry 30 min before close
verifiedCost: Observatory: 29,000 KRW (~$21.50 USD) Adult / Bus 01A or 01B: 1,400 KRW
transitFromHotel: Walk 5 min to Lotte Young Plaza / Myeongdong Stn Exit 3 stop → Take Namsan Shuttle Bus 01A or 01B (~15–20 min ride) directly to N Seoul Tower.
flagNote: Flagged 3 items: (1) Date written as 'Nov 2, 2006' instead of 2026; (2) 'Namsun' spelling typo; (3) '10:00-10:30' omits AM/PM (actual Mon hours: 10:00–22:30, last entry 22:00). Note: Taking Bus 01A/01B brings you directly to the summit plaza without needing the Cable Car.
sourceTitle: N Seoul Tower Official Hours & Admission

itineraryLine: 1b. Cable car + Observatory ticket: $31 each. Cable Car Hours: 10:00-10:30 (weather permitting)
verifiedCost: Cable Car: 15,000 KRW Round-trip / 12,000 KRW One-way. Combined w/ Observatory (29,000 KRW) = 41,000–44,000 KRW (~$30–$32.50 USD)
transitFromHotel: Walk 10 min uphill from Myeong-dong Stn Exit 3, or take the free Namsan Cable Car shuttle bus from Myeong-dong Stn Exit 1 (operates 12:00–20:30).
flagNote: Itinerary lists Cable Car hours as '10:00-10:30' [22:30], whereas official Namsan Cable Car operating hours are 10:00–23:00 daily (last round-trip ticket at 22:30). Also note Namsan Ormi inclined elevator is closed Mondays 09:00–14:00 for maintenance.

itineraryLine: 2. Myeongdong Shopping District — Department Store Hours: Lotte/Shinsegae 10:30-8:00pm (weekdays), 10:30-8:30pm (weekends)
verifiedName: Lotte Department Store Main Branch (롯데백화점 본점) & Shinsegae Main Branch (신세계백화점 본점)
location: Lotte Main: 81 Namdaemun-ro, Jung-gu / Shinsegae Main: 63 Sogong-ro, Jung-gu, Seoul
daysOpen: Daily except 1 monthly Monday closure (varies by month)
verifiedCost: Free entry (Immediate Tax Refund available for foreign tourists)
transitFromHotel: Lotte Main Branch is 1 min across the street from Stanford Hotel Myeongdong; Shinsegae Main Branch is a 6-min walk south along Namdaemun-ro.
flagNote: Minor hours clarification: Extended closing time (20:30) applies on Fridays as well as Saturdays, Sundays, and public holidays (Mon–Thu is 10:30–20:00).

itineraryLine: 2b. Cosmetics Stores: Olive Young 8:00-12:00am, Major brands 10:00-10:00pm
verifiedName: Olive Young Myeongdong Town Global Flagship Store (올리브영 명동타운점)
verifiedCost: Immediate tax refund available on purchases ≥ 15,000 KRW (bring physical passport)
transitFromHotel: 3-minute walk east from Stanford Hotel Myeongdong down Myeongdong-gil.
flagNote: Hours Discrepancy: Itinerary claims Olive Young is open '8:00-12:00am' (08:00–24:00). Official hours for Olive Young Myeongdong Town Flagship are 10:00–22:30 daily.
sourceTitle: VISITKOREA Official — Olive Young Myeong-dong Main Branch

itineraryLine: 2c / 3. Myeongdong Street Food & Myeongdog Night Food Market (Most stalls 11:00-10:00pm, some open until 11:00pm)
verifiedName: Myeong-dong Street Food Alley (명동 밤거리 노점)
transitFromHotel: 2–4 minute walk from Stanford Hotel Myeongdong (along Myeongdong 8-gil from Myeong-dong Stn Exit 6).
flagNote: Typo 'Myeongdog' in prompt. Note: Most street food carts set up in the late afternoon (~15:00–16:00) on weekdays rather than 11:00 AM.
sourceTitle: VISITKOREA Official — Myeong-dong Shopping & Street Food

itineraryLine: 3b. Gwangjang Market - Authentic local cuisine. Netflix famous-get hand-cut noodles. Hours: 9:00-11:00pm. (Some food stalls open until 2:00a.m.)
verifiedName: Gwangjang Market Food Street (광장시장 먹자골목 — Gohyang Kalguksu 고향칼국수)
location: 88 Changgyeonggung-ro, Jongno-gu, Seoul (East Gate Booth #70 for Netflix Kalguksu)
daysOpen: Food Street: Open 365 days/year (General stores closed Sundays)
transitFromHotel: Subway Line 2 Euljiro 1-ga Stn → Euljiro 4-ga Stn Exit 4 (6-min walk north) OR Line 1 Jongno 5-ga Stn Exit 7/8 (12 min total).
flagNote: Official Food Street hours are 09:00–23:00 daily; the claim that stalls stay open until 02:00 AM is not supported by official market hours (most food stalls close by 21:00–23:00).

itineraryLine: 3c. Or go to Mangwon Market - less touristy
transitFromHotel: Subway Line 2 Euljiro 1-ga Stn → Hapjeong Stn → Transfer Line 6 to Mangwon Stn Exit 2 (5-min walk; ~24 min total).
flagNote: Note: Mangwon Market is in Mapo-gu (west Seoul, ~24 min by subway), whereas Gwangjang Market is just 12 min east of Myeongdong.

itineraryLine: Dinner Option 1: Eat at Pig Restaurant 2 - Premium Quality - Itaewon
transitFromHotel: Bus #421 from Lotte Dept Store to Itaewon Stn OR Subway Line 2 → Line 6 to Itaewon Stn Exit 4 (5-min walk; ~20 min total).
flagNote: Flagged as Unverified / Geographic Note: (1) No standalone official website or VISITKOREA page confirms operating hours/prices (social/directory listings report 16:30–24:00, 20,000–40,000 KRW); unconfirmed fields left blank. (2) Located in Itaewon, which is better paired with Day 7 (Saturday - Itaewon).

itineraryLine: Dinner Option 2: Myeongdong Kyoja. Michelin hand-made dumplings. There may be a line.
transitFromHotel: 5-minute walk (450m) from Stanford Hotel Myeongdong.
flagNote: MICHELIN Bib Gourmand selection (2026). Famous for Kalguksu (knife-cut noodles) and Mandu. Note: Per mdkj.co.kr history page, round mandu shaping has been automated since 1983 using fresh daily ingredients.

itineraryLine: Dinner Option 3: Crystal Jade - korean/chinese food (2 locations in Myeongdong. Go to the Shinsegae Dept Store location - basement floor)
verifiedName: Crystal Jade Shinsegae Main Branch (크리스탈제이드 신세계 본점) & Sogong Branch (소공점)
location: Shinsegae Main: B1F, 63 Sogong-ro, Jung-gu / Sogong Branch: B1F Hancom Bldg, 16 Namdaemun-ro 7-gil, Jung-gu
hours: Shinsegae Main B1: Weekdays 10:30–20:00, Weekends 10:30–20:30 / Sogong Branch: 11:00–21:30 (Break 15:00–17:00, L.O. 20:30)
daysOpen: Daily (Shinsegae branch follows department store monthly closure)
transitFromHotel: Sogong Branch is a 2-min walk across from hotel; Shinsegae Main Branch B1 is a 6-min walk south.
flagNote: Verified both nearby branches on crystaljade.co.kr. Note that the Shinsegae Main B1 branch closes early with the department store (20:00 on Monday), whereas Sogong Branch is open until 21:30.
sourceTitle: Crystal Jade Korea Official — Shinsegae Main Branch

itineraryLine: Dinner Option 4: Or Hongojib (full bbq for 1 for only $10)
transitFromHotel: 2-minute walk (150m) from Stanford Hotel Myeongdong (right behind KEPCO building near Euljiro 1-ga Stn Exit 6).
flagNote: Address & official Instagram (@hongojib_1) verified, but exact current operating hours and set menu prices are not published on an official government/tourism website (third-party listings report 11:00–22:00 / 01:00 and sets ~11,900–15,900 KRW); unconfirmed fields left blank.

itineraryLine: Bars: Myeongdong Sookhee
transitFromHotel: 7-minute walk from Stanford Hotel Myeongdong (near Myeong-dong Stn Exit 8).
flagNote: Official Instagram (@soowonopa_sookhee) & address confirmed; operating hours (third-party reported 18:00–01:00) and menu prices are not verified by an official tourism/government site and are left blank.

itineraryLine: 1. Gyeongbokgung Palace (Hours: Nov-Feb 9:00-5:00pm, Last admission 4:00. Closed: Tuesdays) | Admission: 3,000 KRW (~$2.30), Free under 19 & over 65
verifiedCost: 3,000 KRW (~$2.20 USD) Adults (ages 19–64); Free for ages ≤18, ≥65, or wearing Hanbok
transitFromHotel: Subway Line 2 Euljiro 1-ga Stn → Transfer at Euljiro 3-ga Stn to Line 3 → Gyeongbokgung Stn Exit 5 (15 min total).
flagNote: CRITICAL SCHEDULE CONFLICT: Day 3 is Tuesday, Nov 3, 2026, and Gyeongbokgung Palace is CLOSED every Tuesday! (Nov 3 is not a public holiday.) Swap Day 3 with Day 4 (Wed) or Day 6 (Fri), OR visit Changdeokgung/Deoksugung Palace instead (open Tuesdays, closed Mondays).
sourceTitle: Korea Heritage Service — Gyeongbokgung Palace Official

itineraryLine: 2. Must-see: Main palace of Joseon Dynasty, changing of the guard ceremony (10:00 AM, 2:00 PM, closed on Tuesdays)
verifiedName: Gyeongbokgung Palace Royal Guard Changing Ceremony (경복궁 수문장 교대의식)
location: Heungnyemun Gate Plaza, Gyeongbokgung Palace, 161 Sajik-ro, Jongno-gu, Seoul
hours: 10:00 & 14:00 (20 min duration; Gwanghwamun Gate Guard Duty at 11:00 & 13:00)
verifiedCost: Free (Held outside the paid ticket gate at Heungnyemun Plaza)
transitFromHotel: Subway Line 3 Gyeongbokgung Stn Exit 5 or Line 5 Gwanghwamun Stn Exit 2.
flagNote: CRITICAL SCHEDULE CONFLICT: No ceremony takes place on Tuesdays because Gyeongbokgung Palace is closed. Note: Deoksugung Palace (Daehanmun Gate, 10-min walk from Stanford Hotel) holds its Royal Guard Changing Ceremony on Tuesdays at 11:00 and 14:00!
sourceTitle: Korea Heritage Agency Official — Royal Guard Ceremony

itineraryLine: 3. Lunch at traditional restaurant near palace
location: Near Gyeongbokgung Palace / Anguk Station, Jongno-gu, Seoul
transitFromHotel: Walking distance from Gyeongbokgung Palace / Anguk Station.
flagNote: Unspecified venue in itinerary; verified name, hours, and cost left blank per strict verification rules. Official VISITKOREA-listed nearby options include Tosokchon Samgyetang and Hwangsaengga Kalguksu.

itineraryLine: 4. Bukchon Hanok Village (traditional Korean houses). Highlight: Authentic Korean architecture, photo opportunities, craft shops
hours: 10:00–17:00 (Strict Tourist Visiting Hours in Red Zone)
daysOpen: Mon–Sat (Alley restrictions apply; Bukchon Culture Center closed Mondays)
verifiedCost: Free admission (100,000 KRW fine for entering Red Zone outside 10:00–17:00)
transitFromHotel: Subway Line 3 Anguk Stn Exit 2 or 3 (3–5 min walk; ~15 min from hotel).
flagNote: IMPORTANT REGULATION ALERT: Effective Nov 2024 / Mar 2025, tourist entry into the Bukchon residential 'Red Zone' (Bukchon-ro 11-gil) is strictly limited to 10:00–17:00, with a 100,000 KRW fine for violations after 17:00 or before 10:00.
sourceTitle: VISITKOREA Official — Bukchon Tourist Entry Restriction Notice

itineraryLine: 4b. Cafe Onion Anguk, in Hanok (Arrive before it opens, there will be a line)
transitFromHotel: Subway Line 3 Anguk Stn Exit 3 (1-minute walk, 69m).
flagNote: Opens at 07:00 on weekdays (09:00 weekends), making it ideal to visit BEFORE Bukchon Hanok Village opens to tourists at 10:00.
sourceTitle: VISITKOREA Official — Explore Gyeongbokgung & Onion Anguk

itineraryLine: 5. Traditional tea house experience. Activity: Korean tea ceremony, learn about tea culture. Operating Hours: Typically 12:00-9:00, some open until 10:00
transitFromHotel: Walk 5–10 min from Bukchon Hanok Village / Anguk Stn toward Insa-dong.
flagNote: Unspecified venue in itinerary; left blank and flagged as unverified. Official VISITKOREA-verified tea houses nearby include Jeontong Dawon (11-4 Insadong 10-gil, 10:00–22:50), Insa-dong Chatjip (33-1 Insadong-gil, 10:00–21:00), and Osulloc Tea House Bukchon (45 Bukchon-ro).
sourceTitle: VISITKOREA Official — Jeontong Dawon Traditional Tea House
